# Jacob Goldring

> Full stack engineer who builds digital banking for credit unions at Mahalo
> Banking. Also co-founder and CTO of Vamo, a startup for local markets. Works
> remote from Breckenridge, Colorado.

## Mahalo Banking (2022 to now)

Jacob is a Development Engineer 2 at Mahalo Banking. He helped build its online
banking platform from the ground up as a modern rebuild of the original. One
codebase becomes a separately themed app for each credit union. He works
across the whole stack, from React Native and web UI to C# .NET APIs and SQL.
He built many of the platform's features for neurodivergent members and backs
up its mobile DevOps.

## Vamo (2024 to now)

Vamo started as a street food discovery app and grew into one connected
ecosystem for local markets. Its two apps and website run on one Supabase
backend.

- Vamo: for shoppers and vendors. Live on the App Store and Google Play.
- Vamo Host: for the hosts who run markets. Live on the App Store and Google
  Play.
- hellovamo.app: everything the apps do in a browser.

About 200 vendors use Vamo. Vamo is an S corp that operates in Southern
California. Jacob and his business partner are the whole team. He owns
mobile DevOps and is building a Square catalog sync for vendor menus.

## Stack

Mobile: React Native, Expo, TypeScript, Redux Toolkit, React Native Web
Web: Next.js, React, Vue, Tailwind
API: C#, .NET, Entity Framework, Dapper, Azure, Docker
Data: SQL Server, PostgreSQL, Supabase, MySQL
